summary: Post-market read of the 2026-10-06 US session: the composite closed at 50.54, still in caution but 1.83 points lower on the day, with the risk regime unchanged at goldilocks. The easing did not come from rates or credit. Macro is the binding constraint at 73.22 and still rising, with the 10Y at 5.28 from 5.24 and the real rate at 2.92 from 2.88, both sitting at the 99.92nd percentile at once. Credit improved instead: HY OAS tightened to 3.12 from 3.24 and IG to 0.84 from 0.86, and volatility fell to 15.52 from 16.39. The tape was therefore risk-on inside the AI complex - networking added 4.5365, AI infrastructure 2.9666 and data centers 2.5647, 14 of the 22 sectors and themes advanced, AMD rose 2.7622 to 649.200012 and AVGO 3.7282, while memory fell 2.6202 and semiconductor equipment 1.9655. Participation stayed narrow: breadth above the 200-day average is 0.6065, small-cap relative is 8.7019 below, the broad dollar index eased to 121.3848 from 121.7882, and 5 of the 8 production cross-asset signals triggered, keeping cross-asset confirmation at 0.625 as the largest single contribution at 7.5. The mainland leg is frozen - XSHG is closed for the National Day holiday from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-07 and reopens 2026-10-08, so no new A-share close exists and none is quoted here. Fed communication turned hawkish in the same direction as the priced path, with the Fedwatch implied rate at 4.075 against an effective 3.88, and energy stayed expensive with Brent settling at 100.58 and WTI at 89.44.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Macro is the binding constraint at 73.22 and still rising: the 10Y moved to 5.28 from 5.24 and the real rate to 2.92 from 2.88, putting both at the 99.92nd percentile in the same session, while the curve steepened to 0.45.

Cross-asset confirmation remains the largest single contribution at 7.5 on a reading of 0.625, with 5 of the 8 production signals triggering: the dollar index still above its threshold at 121.3848, the real rate at 2.92, small-cap relative at 8.7019 below, and both gold and bitcoin in their risk directions.

The day's tape was risk-on to the extent the layer can verify it: credit improved with HY OAS at 3.12 from 3.24 and IG at 0.84 from 0.86, and volatility fell to 15.52 from 16.39, while the AI complex split - networking added 4.5365, AI infrastructure 2.9666 and data centers 2.5647, but memory lost 2.6202 and semiconductor equipment 1.9655.

Participation remains narrow under the surface rally: breadth above the 200-day average is 0.6065 with 94 of 155 qualifying names, only 16 new highs against 6 new lows of 156 considered, and small-cap relative at 8.7019 below.

The policy path is priced hawkish and Fed communication now agrees: the Fedwatch implied rate is 4.075 against an effective rate of 3.88, and the relayed Fed comments call inflation frustrating with a long way to go and name AI as a major driver.

supporting_signals.claim: Rates evidence advanced a vintage for the first time since 2026-10-02 and moved higher across the curve: dgs10 to 5.28 from 5.24 and dgs2 to 4.83 from 4.78, steepening the curve to 0.45.
Credit tightened on an advanced vintage: HY OAS at 3.12 from 3.24 and IG at 0.84 from 0.86, with the dimension still scoring 61.09 on a falling trend.

AI-infrastructure demand showed up in the equity leg: networking added 4.5365, AI infrastructure 2.9666 and data centers 2.5647, AMD rose 2.7622 to 649.200012 and AVGO 3.7282, and the relayed coverage ties AMD's move to the personal-agent cycle lifting CPU sales.

Volatility and trend inputs stayed supportive: VIX at 15.52 and realized vol at 10.458 keep the volatility dimension at 20.25, with price 7.985 percent above the 200-day average, 3-month momentum at 4.5211 and a 52-week drawdown of 0.0.

contradicting_signals.claim: The composite eased 1.83 on the day, but the dimension that is rising is macro at 73.22, so the apparent calm does not come with any relief on the discount rate.

Credit tightened to 3.12 while the risk-direction signals stayed on: the dollar index level at 121.3848, the real rate at 2.92 and gold up 0.9454 - hedging demand has not cleared even as spreads improved.
Breadth is 0.6065 with small-cap relative at 8.7019 below, so the advance to 14 of 22 sectors and themes rests on a narrow leadership base.

Two legs of the layer are not contemporaneous: the rates and dollar vintages are dated 2026-10-02, 2 sessions behind the layer itself, and the A-share leg carries no new observation because XSHG is closed from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-07.

what_changed_today: The fact layer rolled to the 2026-10-06 session for the first time since 2026-10-02; the composite reset to 50.54 with a 1.83 point daily fall.
Rates advanced a vintage to 2026-10-02 and moved up: dgs10 to 5.28 from 5.24, dgs2 to 4.83 from 4.78, the real rate to 2.92 from 2.88, with the curve at 0.45.
Credit advanced to 2026-10-05 and reversed lower: HY OAS to 3.12 from 3.24 and IG to 0.84 from 0.86.
Volatility advanced to 2026-10-05 with VIX at 15.52 from 16.39, ending the frozen run on the prior layers.
The US equity leg rolled to the 2026-10-06 session: AMD added 2.7622, AVGO 3.7282, TSLA 0.4647 and NVDA 0.0942, while MU fell 1.5715; AMD closed at 649.200012.

Sector and theme dispersion widened inside the AI complex: networking added 4.5365, AI infrastructure 2.9666 and data centers 2.5647, while memory fell 2.6202, semiconductor equipment 1.9655 and AI software 1.3069; 14 of the 22 advanced.

Fed communication turned hawkish and now points the same way as the priced path: the Fedwatch implied rate is 4.075 against an effective 3.88, with inflation called frustrating and AI named as a major driver.
The mainland leg has no new observation: XSHG is closed from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-07 and reopens 2026-10-08, so the A-share values carried in the layer are the 2026-09-30 close.
Energy stayed expensive in the relayed settlement data, with Brent at 100.58 and WTI at 89.44, and RRP drained to 0.414 from 1.004 while bank reserves rose to 2948090 from 2930193.
The consumer signal from the relayed coverage stayed soft, with a reported 6 percent year-over-year fall in US luxury credit card spending for a third straight month.
watch_next: XSHG reopens 2026-10-08 - the first genuine mainland print in a week; does the mainland technology complex confirm or reject the AI-infrastructure rally led by networking, AI infrastructure and data centers?
Whether the 10Y holds at 5.28 and the real rate at 2.92, both at the 99.92nd percentile, against a priced path of 4.075 versus an effective 3.88.
Whether the credit tightening to 3.12 persists or reverses, given that spreads had widened on the two prior layers before this improvement.

Whether the AI-complex split resolves into broader participation: memory fell 2.6202 and semiconductor equipment 1.9655 while networking added 4.5365, and breadth above the 200-day average is only 0.6065.
Whether small-cap relative closes its 8.7019 shortfall, the single clearest sign that the advance is not broad.
The 2026-10-13 bank earnings cluster and the 2026-10-14 CPI print, the first hard tests of the macro dimension after a quiet calendar.
Whether the next volatility observation confirms the fall to 15.52 and whether the rates vintage catches up to the layer date, given it still sits at 2026-10-02.

bull_case.title: AI infrastructure broadens and credit leads
points: Credit is the higher-quality signal: HY OAS tightened to 3.12 from 3.24 and IG to 0.84 from 0.86, and volatility fell to 15.52 from 16.39, so the funding backdrop is improving even while the composite sits in caution.
AI-infrastructure demand is showing up in revenue-linked equity prints: networking added 4.5365, AI infrastructure 2.9666, data centers 2.5647, AMD 2.7622 to 649.200012 and AVGO 3.7282.
The composite fell only 1.83 on the day and the volatility dimension sits at 20.25, with price 7.985 percent above the 200-day average and 3-month momentum at 4.5211 - the trend structure is intact.
Reserves rose to 2948090 from 2930193 and the Fed balance sheet is at 6743031, so the liquidity drain that would normally accompany a 4.075 implied policy path has not yet shown up.

base_case.title: Caution holds as the macro constraint binds
points: The most likely path is consolidation at 50.54: macro is the binding dimension at 73.22 and rising, while liquidity and credit at 61.09, equity structure at 45.13 and trend at 41.19 all carry falling trends.
Rates are the swing factor and they moved the wrong way: dgs10 to 5.28 from 5.24, dgs2 to 4.83 from 4.78 and the real rate to 2.92 from 2.88, with the curve at 0.45.
Participation stays narrow: breadth is 0.6065 with small-cap relative 8.7019 below, and the advance is confined to 14 of the 22 sectors and themes, so upside is carried by a small leadership set.
The priced policy path of 4.075 against an effective 3.88 keeps the real rate at 2.92, so the ceiling on valuation is unlikely to lift without a data surprise.

bear_case.title: Rates and narrow breadth break the goldilocks read
points: The macro dimension at 73.22 is the highest of the 6 and still rising, with the 10Y at 5.28 and the real rate at 2.92 both pinned at the 99.92nd percentile - a level that historically caps equity multiples.
Breadth at 0.6065 understates the problem: only 16 new highs against 6 new lows of 156 names, small-cap relative 8.7019 below, and the semis relative edge is just 0.3132.

The credit improvement may be the anomaly rather than the signal: HY OAS at 3.12 and IG at 0.84 improved on one vintage while the composite and the macro dimension diverged, and RRP drained to 0.414 from 1.004.

The mainland leg cannot be checked for another session: XSHG is closed from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-07 and reopens 2026-10-08, so the layer carries a 2026-09-30 A-share close and the Asia leg offers no confirmation of the AI-infrastructure bid.
